description_en: Creates an ApsaraDB for SelectDB instance
description_zh: 创建一个云数据库 SelectDB 版实例
kebab_example: aliyun selectdb create-db-instance --resource-group-id rg-aekzt2zaluvuvqa_fake --client-token AB --engine selectdb --engine-version 4.1 --charge-type PrePaid --used-time 1 --period Month --db-instance-class selectdb.xlarge --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-e --cache-size 200 --vpc-id vpc-bp175iuvg8nxqraf20000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1gzt31twhlo0sa50000 --db-instance-description New_instance_test --connection-string selectdb-cn-7213c8y0000-public.selectdbfe.pre.rds.aliyuncs.com --security-ip-list 192.168.1.1 --tag Value=testValue Key=testKey --deploy-scheme single_az --multi-zone '[{"ZoneId":"cn-hangzhou-k","VSwitchIds":["vsw-bp10dbralpn4bzmgkkh8f"]}]' --add-vpc-ips 1 --cluster-node-type example-string --cluster-node-count 1 --scale-max example-string --scale-min example-string --config-pattern-type example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotency of the request and prevent repeated submissions. The value is generated by the client, must be unique across different requests, can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters, and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The database engine version. Default value: **4.1**. Valid values:

- 4.0.

- 4.1
parameters.help_zh:
数据库版本，默认值为**4.1**。取值说明：

- 4.0。

- 4.1
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.

- **Prepaid**: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费类型。取值：

- **Postpaid**：后付费（按量付费）。

- **Prepaid**：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:
- If Period is set to Year, valid values of UsedTime are 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5.
- If Period is set to Month, valid values of UsedTime are 1 to 12.
>This parameter takes effect and is required only when **ChargeType** is set to **Prepaid**
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例的购买时长。取值说明：
- 当Period为Year时，UsedTime取值范围为：1、2、3、4、5（整数）。
- 当Period为Month时，UsedTime取值范围为：1~12（整数）。
>仅当**ChargeType**为**Prepaid**时，该参数才生效且为必填参数
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration for the subscription cluster. Valid values:

- **Year**: yearly upfront.
- **Month**: monthly upfront.
> This parameter takes effect and is required only when **ChargeType** is set to **Prepaid**
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费集群为包年或包月类型。取值说明：

- **Year**：包年类型。
- **Month**：包月类型。
> 仅当**ChargeType**为**Prepaid**时，该参数才生效且为必填参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The instance specifications. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2853363.html operation to query available instance specifications
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2853363.html接口查询实例规格
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The IP address whitelist of the instance. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例的IP白名单，多个IP地址请用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en: The deployment mode of the instance
parameters.name: deploy_scheme
